title: [SOA] Clarify Email 2 contact mapping action
summary: The Email 2 contact mapping action in the Sales Order Agent now explicitly clarifies that the sender's email is stored in the selected contact's Email 2 field instead of using the vague term "alternate email".
key_points: Replaces ambiguous wording with explicit field reference
Clarifies that Email 2 field is updated
Improves alignment between action description and actual behavior
Affects Sales Order Agent contact mapping
quote: Updates the contact mapping action to explicitly state that the sender's email is stored in the selected contact's Email 2 field.
